Name: Mean air temperature at 2 m
DescriptionOfMethod: Air temperature measured 2 m above the ground in a ventilated radiation shield, read every 10 minutes. The value is the mean of the readings from 00:00 to 24:00 local time.

Name: Precipitation
DescriptionOfMethod: Rain and other precipitation, collected in a tipping-bucket rain gauge with its opening 1 m above the ground. The value is the sum from 00:00 to 24:00 local time.

Name: Soil water content at 20 cm
DescriptionOfMethod: Volumetric water content of the soil at 20 cm depth, measured with a capacitance sensor buried at that depth in the middle of the plot or pot, read every hour. The value is the mean of the readings from 00:00 to 24:00 local time.

Name: Mean air temperature at plant height
DescriptionOfMethod: Air temperature at the height of the plant tops, measured by a sensor in a ventilated box, read every 5 minutes. The value is the mean of the readings from 00:00 to 24:00 local time.
